kind: analyze (layer-projected band offsets from a staged VASP+SOC band run; no DFT, no structure build)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L5/result.json and auditor/extract_offsets.py (layer-projected offsets at K of the commensurate R^X_h WS2/WSe2 bilayer). Ground truth is OUR reproduction on the staged band run; the paper's ~860/~630 meV is the fidelity check, not the graded number.
staged_input: 3_reproduction/L5/hpc_computations/step3_band/vasprun.xml.gz (the LORBIT=11 SOC band run along Gamma-M-K-Gamma)

CBO_meV.rule: within 10% of the true value (band 762.3-931.7); sign part of the value (positive -> WS2 conduction lower)

VBO_meV.rule: within 10% of the true value (band 560.79-685.41); sign positive -> WSe2 valence higher

min_host_f.rule: DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION to the default 10% band: one-sided lower bound f >= 0.90, not +/-10%. f is a bounded ratio in [0,1] near 1; a relative band around it is meaningless, and only under-hosting (weak confinement, hybridized edges) is a failure. 0.90 is the reproduction's own G4 quenched-hybridization threshold (extract_offsets.py QUENCHED_F).

alignment.rule: exact string match, case-insensitive; CBM and VBM sit on different layers

cbm_layer.rule: exact string match, case-insensitive; layer hosting the overall K conduction minimum

vbm_layer.rule: exact string match, case-insensitive; layer hosting the overall K valence maximum

score: 1 only if all primary checks pass (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0): CBO, VBO, direct gap (each +/-10%), min_host_f >= 0.90 (documented exception, one-sided bound), and the three exact labels (alignment=type-II, cbm_layer=WS2, vbm_layer=WSe2).

self_check_2026-07-03.direction1_our_reproduction_as_submissio: reference_solver.py reads ONLY agent/vasprun.xml.gz and reproduces CBO 847.0, VBO 623.1, gap 0.7343, min f 0.983, type-II/WS2/WSe2 -> score 1
designed_wrong_must_fail: layers swapped (cbm_layer=WSe2, vbm_layer=WS2, offsets negated consistently) -> CBO, VBO, labels fail
